Sign-in help

Forgot password?

Your subscriber number is the 10-digit Zain number on your SIM. Your password is the one you chose when you created your account — use “Forgot password?” if you lost it.

Demo guide

Sign in: any password works — except “Wrong123!”, which shows the wrong-password state. Three wrong tries lock sign-in for 15 minutes.

Sign up: the number 0944 000 000 is already registered. Numbers starting 093, 098 or 099 trigger the carrier dialog. On Set up your number, a number ending in 999 shows the setup-failed state.

Verification code: any 6 digits work; 000000 is always wrong. Three wrong codes invalidate the code; codes also expire after 2 minutes.

Biometric sign-in: the first sensor touch fails on purpose, the second succeeds.
